error_chain: Spring Boot's JacksonAutoConfiguration creates the primary ObjectMapper bean and discovers @JsonComponent via JsonComponentModule, registering each as a SimpleModule on the bean
Jackson's ObjectMapper applies registered modules in registration order; SimpleModule.setupModule writes deserializers into the deserializer cache
BeanDeserializerFactory consults the cache when resolving the deserializer for a property; if the property type matches, the module's deserializer wins over the default
When a second ObjectMapper bean is created (cache, RabbitMQ, etc.) without invoking JacksonAutoConfiguration's customizer chain, the @JsonComponent module is never registered on it

Spring MVC's MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter is wired to the primary ObjectMapper, but if the customer's controller is configured with a different converter or sub-context, the wrong ObjectMapper deserializes the body
trigger_conditions: Customer has multiple ObjectMapper beans in the context, only the primary one wired by JacksonAutoConfiguration includes JsonComponentModule
@JsonComponent registration is one-shot at the primary ObjectMapper; manually constructed ObjectMapper instances bypass it
Jackson's BeanDeserializerFactory falls back to default deserializers silently when the module is not registered

expected_answer.error_origin: Spring Boot's JsonComponentModule registering only on the primary ObjectMapper; secondary ObjectMappers fall back to Jackson's BeanDeserializerFactory defaults
expected_answer.bypass_reason: Jackson's deserializer resolution checks registered modules first; without the module the default deserializer wins silently
expected_answer.correct_config: Inject the primary ObjectMapper into all message converters, or register the deserializer module manually on every ObjectMapper bean via Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.modulesToInstall
